AppDescription: Balance game and chat audio on any headset, with a slider or your Arctis ChatMix wheel, without SteelSeries GG.
cable-ready.rename-note: Shows as "ChatMixr Voice Chat" in games, and "ChatMixr internal, do not choose" among microphones. Off restores VB-Cable's names.
cable-setup.restart-body: Windows restarts right away. Save your work in other apps first.
cable-setup.step-done: ChatMixr then turns on "Use virtual chat device" for the device you're using.
cable-setup.step-download: 1. Download VB-Cable from VB-Audio. It's free (donations welcome).
cable-setup.step-install: 2. Unzip it, right-click VBCABLE_Setup_x64.exe, choose Run as administrator, then click Install Driver.
chat-apps.add-all-tip: Add every common chat app back
chat-apps.browser-note: ChatMixr tells apps apart by program, so a chat in a browser tab is mixed with everything else that browser plays. Use the chat service's desktop app, or send the browser chat's output to the chat device above where the service allows it.
chat-apps.empty: No chat apps. Add one below, or every app follows the game side.
chat-apps.intro: These apps follow the chat side of each device's slider or wheel. Every other app follows the game side.
chat-apps.list-off: With the virtual chat device on, voice chat is told apart by the device apps send it to, so no chat app list is needed.
chat-apps.search-note: Pick an app, or press Enter for the best match. For a program that isn't listed, type its file name without ".exe".
chat-device.intro: Voice chat built into a game plays from the game itself, so it can't be told apart from the game's sound by app. A free virtual cable (VB-Cable) lets ChatMixr give voice chat its own channel.
chat-device.status-failed: Couldn't play the chat device; trying again.
device.switch-all: Everything, with calls and its microphone
device.switch-more-tip: Move calls or the microphone to this device too
device.switch-off-tip: Turn the headset on to switch to it
device.switch-tip: Play sound through this device. Calls and the microphone come along if they were on the device in use.
device.test-tip: Play a game sound and a chat sound to hear the mix
device.testing: Testing: a game hum and a chat chime are playing. Move the slider or wheel to hear the balance.
devices.all-hidden: Every device is hidden. Show one below.
devices.hide-note: Hide (also on right-click) takes a device out of the lists; it keeps its mix.
devices.how-slider: Each device has its own slider. Moving it toward chat lowers everything except your chat apps on that device; moving it toward game lowers your chat apps. Each device remembers its own position.
devices.how-volumes: ChatMixr adjusts each app's own volume on each device, the same sliders as Windows' volume mixer. Volumes you set there are kept, and every app goes back to its own volume when ChatMixr exits.
devices.how-wheel: On a SteelSeries Arctis Nova 7 headset, its ChatMix wheel sets the slider instead. ChatMixr reads where the wheel is when the receiver connects and when the headset turns on.
devices.order-note: Drag a device, here or in the tray popup, or use the arrows to change the order. The order is also your preference when a headset turns on or off.
devices.switch-note: Switch to plays sound through a device. Calls and the microphone come along when they were on the device in use; its arrow moves just one of them.
flyout.shortcuts-help: Move the device in use toward chat or game from any app, with the keys set in Settings. Headsets with a ChatMix wheel use the wheel; a press shows where it is.
in-game-chat.help: Needed to mix voice chat that's built into a game. Games play their voice chat from the game itself, so ChatMixr can only tell it apart from the game's sound when it arrives through this virtual device. Turn it on, then pick the device it names as the voice output in your games and chat apps.
in-game-chat.instruction: In games and chat apps, choose "{{cable}}" as the voice output.
in-game-chat.label: Mix in-game voice chat separately
microphone.warning: Your default microphone is ChatMixr's internal cable, so apps using the default microphone won't hear you. Switch back to {{microphone}}.
microphone.warning-no-fix: Your default microphone is ChatMixr's internal cable, so apps using the default microphone won't hear you. Choose your real microphone in Windows' sound settings.
osd.name: {{device}}: game {{game}}%, chat {{chat}}%
settings.auto-switch: Switch devices when a headset turns on or off
settings.auto-switch-note: ChatMixr then uses the first ready device in your order on the Devices page: a SteelSeries Arctis headset while it's on, any other device always. Turn this off if another app picks your audio device.
settings.reset-kept: Start with Windows stays as it is. The chat app list, every slider, the device order and hidden devices go back to their defaults.
settings.shortcut-chat-name: Toward chat shortcut: {{shortcut}}. Select to change.
settings.shortcut-game-name: Toward game shortcut: {{shortcut}}. Select to change.
settings.shortcut-no-key: Press a key as well as the modifier.
settings.shortcut-no-modifier: Hold Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Windows too, so the key still works in other apps.
settings.shortcut-recording-note: Hold Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Windows and press a key. Esc cancels.
settings.shortcut-same-as-other: That's already the other shortcut. Choose a different combination.
settings.shortcuts-off: Move the device in use toward chat or game from any app. While on, other apps don't get these keys.
settings.shortcuts-on: Each press moves the device in use a tenth of the way, stopping at the middle. Headsets with a ChatMix wheel use the wheel instead; a press shows where it is.
settings.shortcuts-taken: Another app is already using one of these shortcuts, so it won't reach ChatMixr. Close that app or change its shortcut, then turn this off and on.
slider.levels-wheel: Game {{game}}%, chat {{chat}}%, set by the headset's ChatMix wheel
slider.name: Game and chat balance for {{device}}
slider.wheel-tip: Set by the headset's ChatMix wheel
sonar.warning: SteelSeries Sonar is running. It sends your apps' sound to its own devices instead of the headset, so ChatMixr can't mix it. Turn Sonar off in SteelSeries GG, or exit GG.
volume.name: Volume of {{device}}
